column2: A small frontier town square in Missouri in spring 1846, a plain red brick courthouse in the middle, wooden two-storey shops around it, muddy unpaved street full of white canvas covered wagons and oxen, men in wide hats and women in long dresses and bonnets, soft morning light after rain

Inside an 1840s frontier general store, a bearded farmer in a dusty coat at a wooden counter holding a handwritten list, a shopkeeper in an apron behind the counter, shelves with sacks of flour, barrels, coffee tins, lanterns and rope, warm window light

An 1840s frontier blacksmith working at an anvil in an open log forge, hammering a glowing iron hoop for a wooden wagon wheel, wooden wagon wheels and iron tools lying on the earth floor, a farmer in a wide hat watching, warm glow of the forge and sparks

A rough wooden rail pen on open grassland with woods behind it, many oxen standing calmly, young farmers in 1840s clothes and wide hats inspecting the animals, a trader pointing, green grass and spring trees, nothing else in the distance, soft light

A large meadow outside a frontier town in 1846 full of white canvas covered wagons and tents, families cooking at small campfires, laundry hanging between wagon wheels, children running, oxen grazing, a creek with willows, golden evening light

An American farm family in 1846 sitting at a wooden kitchen table in a log farmhouse in the evening, the father reading a letter aloud by candlelight, the mother and several children listening closely, warm candle glow

A small slight elderly woman of sixty-six in 1846 in a dark dress, white cap and bonnet, holding a wooden cane, standing calmly beside a canvas covered wagon at a camp, kind determined face, soft morning light

A young well-dressed gentleman of twenty-two from Boston in 1846, slim, in a travelling coat and hat, standing on a busy river levee beside a paddle steamboat on the Missouri River, with a weathered frontier hunter in buckskin beside him, crates and barrels around

A large family covered wagon in 1846 on a muddy dirt track through green Illinois countryside, a father, a mother and children walking beside it, a girl of twelve riding a small pony alongside, oxen pulling, oak woods, soft spring light

A group of ordinary American farm families in 1846 gathered beside a row of canvas covered wagons, fathers in wide hats, mothers in bonnets, children of all ages, a grandmother sitting on a box, oxen and a few cows, open grassland, gentle morning light

A line of about twenty white canvas covered wagons pulled by oxen rolling out onto green rolling prairie in May 1846, families walking beside the wagons, boys on horseback driving loose cattle at the back, wide sky with white clouds

A group of pioneer men in 1846 gathered around a campfire at dusk inside a circle of covered wagons, one older bearded man standing and speaking, others raising their hands, firelight on their faces, calm

A wide brown river with cottonwood trees on the banks in 1846, a simple flat wooden ferry boat carrying one covered wagon across on a rope, oxen swimming beside a small rowing boat with men guiding them, families waiting on the bank, soft daylight

A vast open green prairie in May 1846 with tall waving grass and wildflowers, blue spiderwort and yellow coneflowers, a small line of covered wagons and walking families in the distance, enormous sky with white clouds, peaceful
Two pale wagon ruts winding over long gentle grassy hills of the prairie in 1846, a few covered wagons and walking people far ahead, distant grey rain shower under a sunny sky, very wide landscape

A large circle of canvas covered wagons on the prairie at dawn in 1846, stars fading in a pale grey sky, pioneers climbing out of wagons, small campfires being lit, smoke rising straight up, oxen inside the circle

A pioneer family in 1846 eating breakfast at a campfire beside their covered wagon in the early morning, coffee pot and skillet with bacon on the fire, a Dutch oven in the embers, mother serving biscuits, children on boxes, soft dawn light
Pioneer men in 1846 placing heavy wooden yokes on pairs of oxen beside covered wagons in the early morning, a long line of wagons ready to move, families waiting, misty prairie, golden low sunlight

Covered wagons stopped on the prairie at midday in 1846, unhitched oxen grazing, families resting in the shade of the wagons eating bread, a man asleep with his hat over his face, children by a small creek, warm light
A circle of covered wagons on the prairie at sunset in 1846, campfires starting inside the circle, oxen grazing outside, a rider returning, the sky glowing orange and pink over the grassland

A pioneer woman in an 1840s bonnet and long dress kneeling by a campfire, lifting the lid of a black cast-iron Dutch oven with hot coals on top to check golden bread, a covered wagon behind her, prairie at morning
Pioneer children in 1846 carrying sacks and baskets across a treeless short-grass prairie gathering dried buffalo chips for fuel, laughing, covered wagons in the distance, wide sky in the afternoon

Pioneer women in 1846 washing clothes at a small creek with washboards and big kettles over fires, clothes spread on the grass and bushes to dry, covered wagons nearby, women talking and smiling, sunny day

A small group of pioneer families in 1846 gathered in the open grass beside covered wagons for a Sunday service, an older man reading from a Bible, people standing with heads bowed, quiet morning light over the prairie
A pioneer girl of about fifteen in 1846 in a bonnet sitting on the wooden tongue of a covered wagon, writing in a small notebook with a pencil, evening light, campfire and other wagons behind her

A close view of a team of patient oxen in wooden yokes pulling a white canvas covered wagon in 1846, a pioneer driver walking on the left side with a long whip resting on his shoulder, dusty trail, warm sunlight

A brown milk cow walking on a rope tied behind a covered wagon on the prairie in 1846, a small wooden chicken coop tied to the side of the wagon, a little boy walking beside the cow, soft afternoon light
A friendly farm dog trotting beside a covered wagon on the prairie trail in 1846, children walking with it, a line of wagons ahead, tall grass and wildflowers, cheerful sunny day
Pioneer children in 1846 kneeling in short prairie grass watching small brown prairie dogs sitting up on mounds by their burrows, covered wagons in the background, wide open plain
Saddle horses grazing at the edge of a wagon camp on the plains in 1846, a young man rubbing down his horse, covered wagons and campfire smoke behind, golden evening sun on the horses' coats

A very wide shallow brown river with many sandbars and small willow islands winding through an endless flat empty grassland to the horizon, a line of covered wagons travelling along the bank in 1846, big sky
Many covered wagons in 1846 spread out side by side across a wide flat river valley, families walking, oxen pulling, dust drifting in the wind, more wagon trains far away along the river
A huge herd of American bison grazing across the plains on the far side of a wide river, pioneer families standing on wagon seats watching from the near bank in 1846, dust in golden light

A towering dark thunderstorm cloud rising over the open plains, rain curtains, lightning far away, a circle of covered wagons waiting calmly below in 1846, cattle standing with backs to the wind, dramatic but peaceful

A rainbow over a wide empty river valley after a storm, wet shining grass to the horizon, low golden sunlight, pioneer families hanging wet blankets over wagon wheels to dry beside their covered wagons, calm evening
A circle of covered wagons on the prairie at dusk, small campfires glowing inside the circle, a deep blue sky with the first stars, a pale green glow on the horizon, peaceful night in 1846

A pioneer family around a campfire at night beside their covered wagon in 1846, the father mending a leather harness, the mother knitting, a teenage boy cleaning a rifle against a wagon wheel, warm firelight, sparks rising

Two pioneer men walking slowly with rifles over their shoulders around a herd of resting oxen on the moonlit prairie in 1846, silver grass, a large rising moon over a river, covered wagons dark in the distance
Covered wagons on the prairie at night with canvas covers glowing softly from candles inside, a brilliant Milky Way stretching across the sky above, dying campfire embers, very peaceful 1846
First light of dawn over a wide prairie river with sandbars, a thin pink and gold line on the horizon, a circle of covered wagons silhouetted on the bank, a lone guard standing, mist on the water
Pioneer young people dancing on trampled grass inside a circle of covered wagons at night in 1846, a man playing a fiddle sitting on a wagon tongue, older people watching and clapping, warm firelight

A simple pioneer wedding on the prairie in 1846, a young bride in her best dress holding wildflowers and a young groom standing before a minister, a company of families gathered around in front of covered wagons, soft morning light
A pioneer mother in 1846 sitting on a quilt in the shade of a covered wagon teaching young children to read from a small book, a child writing letters in the dust with a stick, peaceful noon

Several pioneer women in 1846 sitting together in the shade of a covered wagon stitching a colourful patchwork quilt spread across their knees, talking and smiling, prairie behind them, warm afternoon
A whole wagon camp gathered at several campfires at dusk singing together in 1846, families standing close, faces lit by firelight, covered wagons around, a deep blue sky above the prairie
A huge lonely mass of pale clay and sandstone rising out of a flat dry plain, a line of covered wagons and walking pioneers on the trail in front of it in 1846, sagebrush, clear dry air

A natural eroded sandstone spire, thin and tall like a chimney, rising from the top of a wide cone-shaped hill of pale clay on an empty plain, evening light, covered wagons camped far below with campfire smoke, pioneers looking up at it
Tall weathered bluffs cut into towers and walls like ruins, glowing gold and red in the evening, covered wagons and families travelling through a grassy valley below in 1846, swallows in the sky

A square adobe trading post with high pale walls and corner towers on a low rise above a river in 1846, covered wagons and oxen camped near it, traders and pioneers at the gate, painted tipis further away

A camp of painted Lakota tipis on the plain beside a river in 1846, Lakota families with horses, a few pioneer families with covered wagons visiting and trading cloth for buffalo robes, children looking at each other, respectful peaceful scene

A line of covered wagons travelling through dry high hills covered in grey-green sagebrush in 1846, pale rocks, a dusty trail, families walking, a deep blue sky, a heavy old chest of drawers abandoned beside the trail
Pioneer men in 1846 floating a covered wagon without wheels across a deep fast river on a raft of logs, oxen swimming alongside with men, families waiting on the bank with other wagons, careful work

A huge long low dome of smooth bare grey granite, like an enormous sleeping turtle, rising from an empty plain beside a small river, covered wagons camped around its base, tiny pioneers walking on top of it, 1846

A pioneer man in 1846 kneeling on smooth grey granite with a hammer and chisel, seen from behind, a little girl watching, a wide view from the rock over a river valley with covered wagons far below, sunny day

Pioneers celebrating the Fourth of July in 1846 inside a circle of covered wagons, an American flag of the time on a tall wagon pole, men firing rifles into the air, families at a long supper, music, happy calm evening
A narrow deep gorge cut through a ridge of granite with a clear river rushing at the bottom, pioneers standing at the edge looking down, covered wagons in the valley nearby, 1846
A narrow green river valley with a small clear river, covered wagons travelling along it in 1846, brown hills on both sides, a line of snow-capped mountain peaks on the far horizon, clear morning
A wide high open plateau of grey sage and short grass treeless, covered wagons crossing it slowly in 1846, snowy peaks far to the north, a cold bright morning with a deep blue sky

A marshy green meadow with a cold spring high in the mountains, pioneer families kneeling to drink from the water and filling a bottle, children running around the edge, covered wagons camped nearby, 1846
A small wagon camp beside a little river with willows on a wide high sage plain at dusk in 1846, campfires glowing, oxen grazing, low bluffs on the horizon, purple sky
A wide clear green river between banks of cottonwoods and willows, pioneers floating covered wagons across on rafts with ropes, men shouting, oxen swimming, families watching, 1846, sunny

A small group of log cabins inside a log palisade in a green valley where mountain streams meet, covered wagons and oxen resting nearby, Shoshone tipis and horses along the creek, a weathered mountain man in buckskin at the gate, 1846

Two lines of covered wagons parting ways on a high sagebrush plain in 1846, one turning north and one going southwest, families waving goodbye to each other, mountains in the distance, emotional but calm

A line of covered wagons leaving a small log trading post and heading southwest toward forested mountains on a summer morning in 1846, a girl on a pony riding alongside, families walking, calm and hopeful

A wide green valley with tall grass and clear streams, covered wagons travelling through it in 1846, women and children picking wild currants and gooseberries along a creek, hills around, cheerful sunny day

Natural bubbling mineral springs with orange and white mineral deposits beside a river, pioneer children and adults in 1846 drinking the fizzy water from tin cups, covered wagons nearby, pine-dotted hills

A large square fur trading fort with high whitewashed adobe walls, a big wooden gate and two square corner bastions, on a wide flat plain beside a river in 1846, a red flag on a pole, covered wagons arriving, pioneers and a big Scottish trader in a coat at the gate
A deep canyon of black lava rock with a blue river far below, covered wagons travelling along the dusty sagebrush rim above it in 1846, thirsty oxen, hot hazy sky

Native American Shoshone men with long black hair in buckskin standing on rocky ledges at a low waterfall, spearing leaping salmon with long wooden spears, salmon drying on wooden racks on the bank, white water and sunlight, 1846

Dozens of white waterfalls pouring straight out of the side of tall black basalt cliffs into a blue river at the bottom of a wild empty canyon, small rainbows in the spray, a few pioneers standing on the far rim, 1846

A wide river spreading around a chain of small green islands, covered wagons being pulled across from island to island by chained teams of oxen with men on horseback alongside, 1846, careful calm work
A small adobe trading post where two rivers meet, a little vegetable garden beside it, covered wagons camped nearby at evening, a French trader showing vegetables to pioneers, soft golden light, 1846
Pioneer men in 1846 repairing worn covered wagons at camp beside a river, soaking a wooden wheel in the water, hammering wedges into an iron tyre, patched canvas covers, evening light
A pioneer mother in 1846 sitting inside a covered wagon by the light of a tin lantern mending patched trousers with needle and thread, children asleep under quilts beside her, warm soft glow
A pioneer man in 1846 sitting by a campfire with a small worn guidebook open on his knees, another man pointing at a page, covered wagons behind them in the dusk, firelight

Pioneer families in 1846 trading with Shoshone people beside a river camp, a cotton shirt being exchanged for a large salmon and moccasins, smiles and gestures, tipis and horses, covered wagons, sunny and friendly
An old weather-beaten trapper with a long grey beard in buckskin clothes telling stories at a campfire at night, pioneer children sitting around him in a circle listening, covered wagons behind, 1846

A round green valley ringed by forested mountains with a river winding through tall grass, covered wagons coming down a ridge into it in 1846, pine trees at the edges, Nez Perce horses grazing in the distance

Covered wagons climbing a steep narrow rough track of earth and stones through a forest of tall pines and firs in the mountains in 1846, double teams of oxen pulling, men with axes clearing fallen logs, cool misty air and sunbeams

A small 1840s mission farm of low adobe buildings, a small wooden water mill by a creek, fields of wheat and a young apple orchard in a broad valley, a doctor and his wife greeting tired pioneer families with covered wagons
A wide powerful river flowing through a deep gorge between dark basalt cliffs, treeless dry hills above, covered wagons travelling along the windy southern bank in 1846, sand blowing

A wide river rushing through narrow channels between walls of dark rock with white water, a small mission house on a hill above, covered wagons camped near the river, Native fishermen on the rocks, 1846
Pioneer families in 1846 drifting down a broad river on log rafts loaded with wagon parts and belongings, huge forested cliffs with waterfalls on both sides, morning mist on the water
A stubborn practical pioneer man in his fifties in 1846 standing beside a narrow new road cut through a dense forest of giant fir trees, a simple wooden toll gate, a covered wagon arriving
A snow-covered volcanic mountain peak rising above a vast forest of giant fir and cedar trees, a covered wagon on a narrow forest road below in 1846, sunlight on the snow
Pioneer men in 1846 lowering a covered wagon down a very steep forested slope with ropes wrapped around tree trunks, a cut tree tied behind another wagon as a brake, careful work, tall firs

A pioneer family in 1846 standing at the edge of a forest looking down over a wide green valley with a winding river, oak trees in grassy meadows, a few log cabins with smoke, soft rain and low clouds

A small frontier town of wooden houses, two churches and a mill beside a wide waterfall on a river in 1846, tired pioneer families arriving with worn covered wagons, green forested hills, soft grey light
A small group of covered wagons led by two pioneer men on horseback turning away from the main trail onto a faint new route across a sage plain in 1846, mountains on the horizon
A few tired covered wagons crossing a dry dusty desert in autumn 1846, thin oxen, families walking beside them, low brown mountains, a pale hazy sky

An elderly pioneer woman in a bonnet sitting calmly beside a very old man wrapped in a blanket under a large tree in a dark rainy forest at night, a small fire, two horses tied nearby, quiet and patient
An elderly pioneer woman and a very old man on horseback riding out of a misty forest in the morning into a wagon camp with campfires, family members coming to greet them happily, 1846
A small log house in a green valley on a rainy Christmas evening in 1846, warm light in the window, an elderly woman in a bonnet being welcomed at the door by a minister's family
Close-up of an old woman's hand holding a worn leather glove with a single small old silver coin in its fingertip, on a wooden table by a window, soft light, 1846
A pioneer man in 1846 on horseback in a green meadow beside a stream with oak trees, marking a corner of his land by piling stones, forested hills behind, soft spring light
Pioneer neighbours in 1846 building a log cabin together, lifting a notched log onto the walls, a man splitting cedar boards, women and children watching, autumn trees in a green valley

Inside a one-room log cabin on a rainy winter evening in 1846, a pioneer family sitting by a stone and clay fireplace, the father making a wooden bench, the mother sewing, children on a straw bed, warm firelight
High snowy mountains and a frozen lake far away under a grey winter sky, a few small cabins seen from a great distance among pine trees, very calm and quiet, 1846
A pioneer man in 1846 ploughing dark soil with a pair of oxen beside a new log cabin in a green valley, his wife planting a garden, small young apple trees, wildflowers and oak trees in spring
A pioneer family in 1847 sitting outside their log cabin in the evening looking over golden wheat fields, a snow-capped volcanic peak far away catching the sunset, blue hills, peace
A very long line of covered wagons stretching to the horizon across the prairie in the years around 1850, many families walking, dust in golden light
An early steam train of 1869 with wooden carriages crossing the open plains, passengers looking out of the windows, faint old wagon ruts in the grass beside the track, wide sky

Two deep parallel trenches worn by old wagon wheels into a ridge of pale sandstone, as deep as a person is tall, a family of visitors walking along the bottom touching the smooth stone walls, juniper bushes on the ridge, quiet sunlight

A huge long low dome of bare grey granite beside a small river on a wide empty plain, weathered smooth rock, sagebrush and wild grass all around, gentle late afternoon light, a quiet peaceful landscape
A peaceful green farm valley with an old weathered wooden barn and an apple orchard, rolling hills with fir forests, a snow-capped mountain far away, soft grey clouds
A single covered wagon with a pioneer family walking beside it on the open prairie at sunset in 1846, long shadows, golden grass, the sky glowing orange and violet, peaceful ending
